If you wish to monitor for signs during training, observe for:
- Visible doming or bulging along the midline of the abdomen during exertion (e.g., when rising from supine, during planks, or other core exercises)

If any of these are present, pause progression and refer to a pelvic health specialist. Always prioritize safety and professional assessment for postpartum clients.
